This game has been sitting in my library with an absurd amount of dust since the end of 2015, and for what purpose? [b]It came from space and ate our brains[/b] is actually entertaining. Now, I'm not entirely sure what possessed me to purchase this game in the first place, be it the flashy colors or some absurdly cheap sale; that remains to be seen, but I am sort of shooting myself in the foot for not giving this a chance sooner.

[i]It came from space and ate our brains[/i] is, for all intents and purposes, an arcade shooter where you run around shooting silly pink aliens with stupid faces as they try to slither at you and eat your brains. This is all, of course, from a simple top-down perspective and done in a minimalist art style that sits somewhere between awkwardly endearing and seizure-inducing. It works really well though. Instead of over-complicating the screen with too much user interface, it keeps all the vital information in the corners and allows for the screen to be bombarded with as much glowing pink absurdity as it can. While all this is going on, the music is oscillating between eerie tones and a maddening techno remix of cheesy 80's alien horror B-movie tunes, which adds a nice layer to it.

It does have a few minor hindrances, however. The controls are a bit finicky and at times it feels like no amount of direct shots do what they're supposed to. This is most apparent with a fully-upgraded laser gun, which seems to only hit some of the time. But to contrast that, the game can likely run on a potato and it does seem like a fantastic co-op experience should I ever feel willing to play with others. Mind you, from what I understand, the online multiplayer support appears to be gone and there is no dedicated server from what I can tell, so playing co-op would require some manner of witchcraft to do successfully.

That's it. I haven't more to say about this title, as it's rather face-value. I'd recommend it for any players out there who enjoy a nerve-wracking arcade style who enjoy the sort of shenanigans that can only be had by shooting neon-pink blobs with silly faces on them.

Just a few too many ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ prevent this game from being up there with the great top-down shooters such as Assualt Android Cactus, Crimsonland or Neon Chrome. The gameplay is really not bad: pick off aliens with your weapon of choice as you roam around dark environments picking up power-ups and upgrading your weapon. Some enemies charge at you, some leap at you frog-like, some are huge tanks while others snap around teleporting a short distance. Mowing them down is satisfying enough but...

1) The game is unnecessarily dark.
2) Enemies are sometimes hard to see and easy to bump into.
3) Some will spawn too close or virtually on top of you.
4) The environments are a little claustrophobic.
5) The aliens are all the same colour (why not have different colours for different types?)
6) Levels are hard to unlock. (I've unlocked just three in 3 hours of gameplay.)
7) There is no explanation highlighting how they get unlocked.
8) Hard if not impossible to navigate menus with a controller.
9) Sometimes it will only let you start a game with a mouse click (rather than a controller) forcing you to play with mouse+keyboard.
10) Power-up symbols are just boring cubes.

The game had loads of promise when I first purchased it but it kind of loses its appeal very quickly and sessions rarely amount to completing 1 or 2 levels. For a similar gameplay experience but for something more addictive and presented way better, I'd heartily recommend Meltdown instead.

А играть нам нужно за копа, который будет отстреливаться от злостных инопланетян, которые волнами будут нападать на вас на протяжении 12 карт, доступных в игре. Помимо этих карт есть 4 уровня сложности, которые мало чем отличаются друг от друга. При желании можно пройти инсейн, главное выработать тактику. Враги становятся быстрее, денег за них дают меньше, а так - по количеству, вроде бы, то же самое. 

Кстати о валюте в игре, вам будет капать денежка за убийство инопланетян, которую вы можете тратить на всякие приблуды, вроде оружия, несколькоэтапного апгрейда его же, ну и там на медкиты [i](аптэчка, друг)[/i], турели и тд. На каждой карте вам нужно качать все по-новой. Не могу сказать, что это очень радует... 

Геймплей проще простого - отстоять 6 волн на каждой карте и жать пкм. 
Визуальное решение не ново, но в играх с подобной графикой очень редко выстреливает. Это как раз тот случай, где она уместна. 

Слышал, что игра непопулярна, хотя в ней есть кооператив [i](до 4х человек)[/i]. Ради того, собственно, мы и взяли эту игрушку и не пожалели. В стиме не так уж и много игр, в которые можно было бы поиграть компанией. Так что, на вечерок-другой, эта вам точно подойдет. 

Единственное, чего не хватило этой игре - огромного жирного босса, который кидался бы слизнями и улыбался. Кстати об улыбках, у меня на протяжении всей игры преследовала мысль, что я дерусь с мармеладными Домо [i](японский персонаж из мультфильма)[/i].
